LESSON: WEAVING

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: CREATIVE ARTS
Strand: Creating and Executing
Topic 1.5: Weaving

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Weaving
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
